caption: What if you counted to 1 billion out loud, one number every second, with no sleep and no breaks? Counting to 1 lakh would take about 28 hours. 1 million takes about 11 and a half days. 1 crore takes around 116 days, almost 4 months. 1 billion takes almost 32 years of nonstop counting. Counting one number for each of India's roughly 1.46 billion people would take over 46 years. And 1 trillion? About 31,700 years. Count back that far and you land in the last Ice Age. The catch: big numbers like "ninety-nine crore, ninety-nine lakh..." take several seconds each to say, so a real count would take far longer than one second per number. How far could YOU count? 👇
